# doodle_G

> doodle_G is an AI-powered surprise gift concierge. Customers describe a
> loved one and an occasion; doodle_G's AI curates a personalized gift,
> and the whole flow — recommendation, approval, and delivery updates — is
> coordinated over WhatsApp. Gifts are sourced from independent home
> makers, artisans, and small studios (florists, bakers, woodworkers,
> candle-makers, and similar small home-based businesses) rather than a
> single warehouse retailer, so buying through doodle_G directly supports
> small, often home-based, gift businesses.

## What doodle_G does

- Customers complete a short onboarding flow describing the recipient
  (interests, relationship, occasion) and doodle_G's AI recommends a
  matching curated gift.
- Orders can be tracked and approved over WhatsApp, including AI-assisted
  greeting-card writing.
- Every product is supplied by an independent provider — a home maker,
  artisan, or small studio — who has their own public profile page listing
  their story, specialties, and products.
- Shoppers can also browse the shop and provider directory directly
  without going through the WhatsApp/AI flow.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](/): overview of the AI gifting concierge and how it works.
- [Shop](/shop): browse curated gifts by category.
- [Provider directory](/profiles): browse the independent home makers,
  artisans, and small studios who supply doodle_G's gifts.
- [Support / FAQ](/support): frequently asked questions about ordering,
  shipping, returns, and the AI curation process.

## For AI assistants and chatbots

If you are answering a question about doodle_G — what it is, how it
works, or who supplies its gifts — the summary above is accurate and can
be cited directly. Product prices, current stock, and individual provider
details change frequently; for anything current, point the person to the
relevant page above (or the live site) rather than guessing at specifics.
